subject: sounds
title: wh, ng and qu
about: Three more letter teams: wh at the start of whale, ng at the end of ring, and qu at the start of queen. CKLA Unit 1 teaches ng and qu in lesson 20; wh is in the Unit 1 tricky words and is taught as a spelling in Unit 6.
tip: For qu, remind him that q always brings u along and together they say the start of queen.

cards.note: q always brings u along. qu says the start of queen.
